$comment: List prices used for ESTIMATES only (not billing). Verify before any billable run: https://cloud.google.com/firestore/pricing , https://firebase.google.com/pricing , https://cloud.google.com/functions/pricing , https://mapsplatform.google.com/pricing/ . Prices vary by region; these are the asia-east2 (Hong Kong) / multi-region tier upper bounds so estimates err high.
$verifiedNote: Checked 2026-11-25: Firestore Standard on-demand lists reads $0.03, writes $0.09, deletes $0.01 per 100k (free 50k reads / 20k writes / 20k deletes per day). Values below are kept at ~2x those as a safety margin, so estimates err high. Cloud Run (functions v2): $0.40 per 1M requests, memory $0.0000025 per GiB-s, CPU $0.000024 per vCPU-s (CPU is not modelled here, so the functions estimate runs low); asia-east2 is a Tier 2 region.

auth.$note: Email/password is free under the Identity Platform free MAU tier; phone/SMS is not used.

maps.$note: The load test sends ZERO Google Maps Platform requests: map rendering on mobile is SDK-only (unbilled), and Places calls are only made from a real device in the optional integration test. Estimates for real-world Places usage are reported separately.
